mapper.sql: select c.id, c.class_period, c.head_teacher_id, c.campus_id, c.course_id, c.created_at, c.updated_at, coalesce(nullif(u.nickname, ''), nullif(u.real_name, ''), u.username) as head_teacher_name, camp.campus_location as campus_name, co.course_name as course_name from sys_class c left join sys_user u on u.id = c.head_teacher_id left join sys_campus camp on camp.id = c.campus_id left join sys_course co on co.id = c.course_id
mapper.insert: insert into sys_class (class_period, head_teacher_id, campus_id, course_id, created_at, updated_at) values (#{classPeriod}, #{headTeacherId}, #{campusId}, #{courseId}, now(), now())
mapper.update: update sys_class set class_period = #{classPeriod}, head_teacher_id = #{headTeacherId}, campus_id = #{campusId}, course_id = #{courseId}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
